sections.chapter_title: Serial peripheral interface / integrated interchip sound (SPI/I2S)
sections.text_helper: Section 27.5.3 "Standard multislave communication" in chapter 27 (Serial peripheral interface / integrated interchip sound (SPI/I2S)), RM0490 Rev 6, page 835.
sections.section_content:
In a configuration with two or more independent slaves, the master uses GPIO pins to
manage the chip select lines for each slave (see Figure283). The master must select one of
the slaves individually by pulling low the GPIO connected to the slave NSS input. When this
is done, a standard master and dedicated slave communication is established.
[Figure 283. Master and three independent slaves]
